summary: Retest after SecureStore web shim fix. SecureStore shim works (no ExpoSecureStore/getValueWithKeyAsync errors). Found and fixed two follow-on bugs in app/(admin)/dashboard.jsx: (1) leftover `import * as SecureStore from expo-secure-store` plus undefined `secureDelete` call in handleSignOut, (2) `useFocusEffect` imported from `@react-navigation/native` which threw 'Couldn't find a navigation object. Is your component inside NavigationContainer?' and crashed Dashboard immediately after login. Both fixed; after fixes admin login → dashboard → manage-drivers all render cleanly on mobile viewport via the preview URL.
action_items: Sweep the repo for any other `useFocusEffect` imported from '@react-navigation/native' — must come from 'expo-router' when using expo-router. Suggested: `grep -rn "from \"@react-navigation/native\"" /app/frontend/app /app/frontend/lib` and migrate useFocusEffect (and any useNavigation) imports.
Sweep for any remaining direct `import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store'` usages outside lib/secure.js — they must all go through lib/secure.js shim or web will break again.

Note: Alert.alert from React Native shows nothing on web — sign-out (which relies on Alert.alert confirmation) effectively does nothing on web. Consider Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm(...) : Alert.alert(...).

Driver create + driver login flow was not exercised end-to-end in this iteration (admin/dashboard/manage-drivers reachable; creating a driver requires hitting live backend and was not attempted to keep scope tight). Main agent to validate that flow once above fixes are merged.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(admin)/dashboard.jsx had a dead `import * as SecureStore` plus a call to an undefined `secureDelete` — would throw on sign-out. Fixed by importing { deleteItem as secureDelete } from '../../lib/secure'.
Mixing @react-navigation/native hooks inside an expo-router app is fragile — useFocusEffect must be imported from 'expo-router' to share the same NavigationContainer.
Alert.alert is a no-op on web — any onPress that depends on its callback (sign-out here) will silently never run on web.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows (login, dashboard render, navigation to Manage Drivers) after fixes

rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 blocker: expo-secure-store@55 web entry crashes (getValueWithKeyAsync undefined). Iteration 1 added a Platform-aware shim at lib/secure.js and replaced SecureStore calls in app entry/auth/admin/driver. RCA for iteration 2 follow-ons: (a) dashboard.jsx still had a `import * as SecureStore` and used `secureDelete` without importing it — would crash on signout; (b) dashboard.jsx imported `useFocusEffect` from '@react-navigation/native' which, under expo-router, resolves to a hook that calls useNavigation() outside the active NavigationContainer and throws 'Couldn't find a navigation object'. Fix: replace import with `import { useRouter, useFocusEffect } from "expo-router"` and replace SecureStore import with `import { deleteItem as secureDelete } from "../../lib/secure"`. Verified by reloading preview URL with cleared localStorage, performing admin login (tirumalboga713@gmail.com/12345678) — admin-dashboard testID rendered, stat cards visible, Manage Drivers nav reached add-driver-btn; zero SecureStore- or navigation-object-related console errors.
